story: [R00] Raid 1 — Encounter 1 begins.

[R01] Kel MISTAKE · Moderate · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank
      "Kel is being chased by something enormous and is telling everybody about it as it happens."

[R01] Steve MISTAKE · Severe · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank
      "Steve was aiming at the adds, and the boss was standing in the adds, and here we are."

[R01] Natsuna MISTAKE · Minor · Healed the Wrong Target (after g07:r1:MIS_AGGRO, depth 1)
      "Natsuna healed a tank, just not the tank that was being hit."

[R01] Fern MISTAKE · Minor · Healed the Wrong Target (after g07:r1:MIS_AGGRO, depth 1)
      "Fern is keeping somebody alive who was never in any danger, and doing it beautifully."

[R01] Lyra MISTAKE · Severe · Went AFK
      "Lyra is present, attentive, and facing entirely the wrong way."
[R01] Lyra has wandered off for three rounds.
[R02] Bob taunts the boss back.

[R02] Natsuna MISTAKE · Minor · Healed the Wrong Target (after g07:r1:MIS_AGGRO, depth 1)
      "Natsuna healed Natsuna, who had taken one hit and felt it keenly."

[R02] Fern MISTAKE · Minor · Healed the Wrong Target (after g07:r1:MIS_AGGRO, depth 1)
      "Fern got there first, which counts for something, and healed the wrong person, which counts for less."

[R02] Natsuna MISTAKE · Severe · Went AFK (after g07:r1:MIS_AGGRO, depth 1)
      "Natsuna is standing perfectly still with the calm of somebody who has gone to answer the door."
[R02] Natsuna has wandered off for three rounds.

[R03] Fern MISTAKE · Severe · Healed the Wrong Target (after g07:r1:MIS_AGGRO, depth 1)
      "Fern heals somebody who was at full health, who did not need it, and who says thank you."

[R03] Kel MISTAKE · Minor · Went AFK
      "Kel has decided this is a good round to sit out, and told nobody."
[R03] Kel has wandered off for a round.

[R03] Lyra MISTAKE · Severe · Started an Argument in Raid Chat
      "Lyra brought up the seating plan for the guild dinner, mid-pull."
[R03] Lyra drags Wanda into it.

[R04] Greg MISTAKE · Moderate · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank
      "Greg assumed the tank would take it back, and the tank assumed Greg had a plan."
[R05] Adds join the fight.

[R05] Bob MISTAKE · Minor · Forgot to Taunt
      "Bob genuinely thought it was the other one's turn, and can explain the rotation to you afterwards."
[R06] Bob taunts the boss back.

[R06] Zed MISTAKE · Critical · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank
      "Zed has one spell that is far better than the others and has now cast it four times running."

[R07] Dave MISTAKE · Moderate · Started an Argument in Raid Chat
      "Dave is defending a friend who has not asked to be defended, and is losing."
[R07] Dave drags Zed into it.

[R07] Zed MISTAKE · Moderate · Started an Argument in Raid Chat (after g01:r7:MIS_ARGUMENT, depth 1)
      "Zed would like everybody to know who pulled that, and everybody now does."
[R07] Zed drags Kel into it.

[R08] Bob MISTAKE · Moderate · Forgot to Taunt
      "Bob counted to three and waited for the other tank's nod, and the other tank was counting too."

[R08] Wanda MISTAKE · Moderate · Attacked the Wrong Target
      "Wanda lost the marked one in the crowd and settled for enthusiasm."

[R08] Zed MISTAKE · Critical · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank (after g10:r6:MIS_AGGRO, depth 1)
      "Zed opened at full strength on round one, because opening at half strength has never once felt good."

[R08] Natsuna MISTAKE · Minor · Bounced the Chain Heal Into Nobody (after g00:r8:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 1)
      "Natsuna did not know the raid had spread out, and the raid did not know Natsuna was casting."

[R08] Fern MISTAKE · Minor · Healed the Wrong Target (after g00:r8:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 1)
      "Fern healed the loudest raider rather than the quietest one, and the quiet one is the problem."
[R09] Bob taunts the boss back.

[R09] Dave MISTAKE · Minor · Forgot to Taunt (after g01:r7:MIS_ARGUMENT, depth 1)
      "Dave is holding the line beautifully, several steps to the left of where the line is."

[R09] Kel MISTAKE · Critical · Facepulled the Next Group
      "Kel stepped forward to check something and checked it thoroughly."

[R10] Greg MISTAKE · Moderate · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank
      "Nobody asked Greg to go first, and nobody has ever needed to."

[R10] Natsuna MISTAKE · Severe · Healed the Wrong Target (after g05:r10:MIS_AGGRO, depth 1)
      "Natsuna set the totem down beside somebody lovely and entirely out of the way."

[R10] Natsuna MISTAKE · Moderate · Started an Argument in Raid Chat (after g05:r10:MIS_AGGRO, depth 1)
      "Natsuna has opinions about the composition and has been waiting for a gap to share them."
[R10] Natsuna drags Kel into it.
[R11] Steve is DOWNED.

[R11] Bob MISTAKE · Moderate · Forgot to Taunt
      "Bob looked over at the boss, decided it seemed settled, and let it settle."

[R11] Fern MISTAKE · Minor · Healed the Wrong Target (after g00:r11:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 1)
      "Fern is topping up the raider who is fine, because the one who is not fine is hard to look at."
[R12] Steve is DOWNED.
[R12] Bob taunts the boss back.

[R12] Dave MISTAKE · Minor · Forgot to Taunt
      "Dave did taunt. Very quietly, and slightly too late, and while facing the wall."

[R12] Kel MISTAKE · Moderate · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank (after g07:r9:MIS_FACEPULL, depth 1)
      "Kel is now the most interesting person in the room and would very much like to stop being that."

[R12] Cindy MISTAKE · Moderate · Healed the Wrong Target (after g01:r12:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 1)
      "Cindy has notes on why the other healer should have had that, and used this round to write them."
[R13] Steve is DOWNED.

[R13] Dave MISTAKE · Severe · Forgot to Taunt (after g01:r12:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 1)
      "Dave refuses to yield the front, and also refuses to say anything while standing on it."

[R13] Zed MISTAKE · Moderate · Attacked the Wrong Target
      "Zed spent the whole round on a target that had eleven other people on it."

[R13] Natsuna MISTAKE · Severe · Healed the Wrong Target (after g01:r13:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 2)
      "Natsuna was watching the wrong raider with total dedication."

[R13] Fern MISTAKE · Severe · Healed the Wrong Target (after g01:r13:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 2)
      "Fern picked a name off the list, and the list is sorted alphabetically."

[R13] Lyra MISTAKE · Moderate · Went AFK
      "Lyra will be back. Lyra has said so, repeatedly, from somewhere else."
[R13] Lyra has wandered off for two rounds.
[R14] Steve is DOWNED.
[R14] Zed is DOWNED.

[R14] Dave MISTAKE · Minor · Forgot to Taunt (after g01:r13:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 2)
      "Dave shouted at the boss, which felt like taunting and was in fact just shouting."

[R14] Greg MISTAKE · Minor · Attacked the Wrong Target
      "Greg was already behind something, and moving would have wasted the position."

[R15] Zed is DOWNED.

[R16] Natsuna is DOWNED.

[R16] Bob MISTAKE · Moderate · Forgot to Taunt
      "Bob assumed the boss had understood the arrangement."

[R16] Dave MISTAKE · Minor · Forgot to Taunt (after g01:r14:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 3)
      "Dave was mid-sentence about last week's wipe when the round came round again."

[R16] Steve MISTAKE · Moderate · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank
      "Steve would like it on record that the boss turned around of its own accord."

[R16] Wanda MISTAKE · Moderate · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank (after g09:r8:MIS_WRONG_TARGET, depth 1)
      "The boss was busy with somebody else, which Wanda read as an opportunity rather than as the plan working."

[R16] Natsuna MISTAKE · Minor · Bounced the Chain Heal Into Nobody (after g00:r16:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 1)
      "Natsuna sent it out hopefully and got nothing back but the sound of it landing."

[R16] Fern MISTAKE · Severe · Healed the Wrong Target (after g00:r16:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 1)
      "Fern healed the raider who asked, rather than the one who is too busy to ask."
[R17] Zed is DOWNED.
[R17] Natsuna is DOWNED.

[R17] Natsuna MISTAKE · Minor · Healed the Wrong Target (after g00:r16:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 1)
      "Natsuna is saving the big heal for somebody who deserves it more, which is a philosophy, not a plan."

[R17] Wanda MISTAKE · Moderate · Started an Argument in Raid Chat (after g09:r8:MIS_WRONG_TARGET, depth 1)
      "Wanda corrected somebody's pronunciation of the boss's name and the room turned."
[R17] Wanda drags Bob into it.
[R18] Zed is DOWNED.
[R18] Natsuna is DOWNED.
[R18] Bob taunts the boss back.

[R18] Pip MISTAKE · Severe · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank
      "Pip was behind the boss, technically, right up until the boss stopped being where it was."

[R18] Kel MISTAKE · Severe · Facepulled the Next Group (after g07:r9:MIS_FACEPULL, depth 1)
      "Kel was sure they had not seen Kel, and they had."

[R18] Natsuna MISTAKE · Moderate · Bounced the Chain Heal Into Nobody (after g06:r18:MIS_AGGRO, depth 1)
      "Natsuna needed two raiders standing near each other, which is more than this raid can promise."

[R18] Zed MISTAKE · Severe · Started an Argument in Raid Chat (after g09:r17:MIS_ARGUMENT, depth 2)
      "Zed has apologised in a tone that has started a second argument."
[R18] Zed drags Lyra into it.
[R19] Natsuna is DOWNED.
[R19] Greg is DOWNED.
[R19] Zed is DOWNED.

[R19] Steve MISTAKE · Moderate · AoE'd the Sleeping Add
      "Steve saw four targets and could not see a reason not to hit four targets."

[R19] Wanda MISTAKE · Moderate · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank (after g09:r8:MIS_WRONG_TARGET, depth 1)
      "Wanda saw a big number, chased a bigger one, and is now the big number."

[R19] Natsuna MISTAKE · Moderate · Healed the Wrong Target (after g09:r19:MIS_AGGRO, depth 2)
      "Natsuna healed Natsuna, who had taken one hit and felt it keenly."

[R19] Bob MISTAKE · Moderate · Called Loot Before the Boss Died (after g10:r18:MIS_ARGUMENT, depth 3)
      "Bob has done the arithmetic on who deserves the drop and shared the working."

[R20] Greg is DOWNED.
[R20] Zed is DOWNED.
[R20] Natsuna is DOWNED.

[R21] Steve is DOWNED.

[R22] Natsuna is DOWNED.

[R22] Zed is DOWNED.

[R22] Bob MISTAKE · Moderate · Forgot to Taunt
      "Bob had one job this round and got absorbed in a different, more interesting job."

[R22] Dave MISTAKE · Minor · Forgot to Taunt (after g01:r20:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 1)
      "Dave was watching the fight closely and appreciatively, the way you watch a fight you are not in."

[R22] Kel MISTAKE · Minor · Attacked the Wrong Target (after g07:r18:MIS_FACEPULL, depth 2)
      "Kel committed to a target early and is seeing it through on principle."

[R22] Dave MISTAKE · Severe · Went AFK (after g01:r22:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 2)
      "Dave is not here. Dave's body is here."
[R22] Dave has wandered off for three rounds.

[R22] Pip MISTAKE · Minor · Went AFK
      "Pip stepped away for one moment, at the start of a fight that has moments in it."
[R22] Pip has wandered off for a round.

why: The opening disaster: a fresh guild of nobodies meets four trash mobs.
